policy.note: Do not label eras on screen. One world changing around the same needs.

staging: assistive synthetic voice used by a living person
reconstructed voice of a deceased person (clearly not the same ethical class)
old factory frames become non-city structures
possible_futures.benefit: Speech and presence restored for the living who need assistive tools.
possible_futures.cost: Memorial reconstruction can replace grief with a controllable ghost.
possible_futures.gesture_of_care: Someone adjusts a device so another person can finish a sentence.
possible_futures.temptation_toward_control: Loop the reconstructed voice until it cannot surprise.
possible_futures.dionysian_echo: Living variation of the family melody against a too-perfect memorial loop.

beats.action: Coloured blocks or monitors judging workers
The ancestor repairs a stranger's sleeve
The stranger frees the ancestor when his coat catches
An injured worker asks for help while the melody draws Oino onward

movements.benefit: Shared power of water and steam multiplies what hands alone can feed and warm.
movements.cost: Judgment systems and machines rank bodies; injury and exhaustion stay visible.
movements.gesture_of_care: Ancestor repairs a stranger's sleeve; stranger frees the caught coat.
movements.temptation_toward_control: Coloured blocks/monitors that score workers instead of seeing them.
movements.dionysian_echo: Children singing the family contour as loom/work rhythm (life-force in labour song).

beats.action: Electric light genuinely relieves domestic labour
A woman dances because a machine returns time to her
Another household waits beside an empty chair
An alarm becomes the rhythm of people gathering and organizing
Show benefit and absence in the same visual movement

movements.benefit: Light and machines return hours of life — a woman can dance.
movements.cost: Another home keeps an empty chair; relief is unevenly distributed.
movements.gesture_of_care: Neighbors organize to the alarm rhythm — mutual aid, not panic.
movements.temptation_toward_control: Schedule every returned hour so nothing is wasted or free.
movements.dionysian_echo: Dance rhythm of the family melody under electric lamps (joy without erasing the empty chair).

beats.action: A person types a private admission into a terminal
A distant relative appears through a network
Faces repeat with slight timing differences
Oino sees her own recording playing without her
Every corridor offers a cleaner version of a lost voice

movements.benefit: Confession and kinship can travel distance; the lonely can be answered.
movements.cost: Self and dead voices become editable loops; presence without presence.
movements.gesture_of_care: A relative stays on the line until the admission is finished.
movements.temptation_toward_control: Play Oino's recording without her — perfect, interruptible, owned.
movements.dionysian_echo: Too-perfect memorial loop of the melody in the corridor; slight timing errors as living tremor.

movements.title_internal: Assistance, memorial presence, and possible futures

beats.action: A living person speaks through an assistive synthetic voice
A deceased person's voice is reconstructed
Old factory frames become structures that do not resemble cities
An ordinary table appears at the centre

movements.benefit: Assistive voice returns agency to the living speaker.
movements.cost: Reconstructed dead speech can sell comfort as ownership of the lost.
movements.gesture_of_care: Hands set bowls on the ordinary table for whoever still arrives.
movements.temptation_toward_control: Prefer the reconstructed voice to the living person's slower assistive speech.
movements.dionysian_echo: Wine-coloured light on the table; melody as nourishment, not spectacle.
